moments.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: David hid himself in the field, and when the new moon was come the king sat down to eat. David fled at the first of the month, and at the new moon meal his seat was empty.

note.label: 1 Samuel 20: David's Empty Seat at the New Moon

points: That first day Saul spake not anything, for he thought something had befallen David, that surely he was not clean; but on the second day of the month, with David's place empty again, Saul asked Jonathan, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat?

note.label: 1 Samuel 20: David's Empty Seat at the New Moon

points: Saul got wind that his own son was hiding David out. When Jonathan covered for David, Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan: as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom.

note.label: 1 Samuel 20: David's Empty Seat at the New Moon

points: Saul cast a javelin at Jonathan to smite him, whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David; from here the history follows Saul pursuing David.

note.label: 1 Samuel 20: David's Empty Seat at the New Moon

points: Shewbread, lunar Sabbath, new moon: where is this going? Everywhere. Many who push this doctrine cannot read it properly or count properly, so read the history.

David fled and came before Jonathan: “What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?” Jonathan answered, “God forbid; thou shalt not die”: whatever Saul plans to do to you, I’ma know first. That was not true, but Jonathan believed at first that his father would tell his son whatever he planned against David.

David swore that Saul was hiding it from Jonathan, “lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.” Your father wants me dead, Jonathan, you don’t know what you’re talking about. Jonathan: “Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.” I got your back, David, you going to be all right, I’m going to keep you safe.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “Behold, to morrow is the new moon.” Tomorrow is the new moon, tomorrow is the new moon: pay close attention to this particular history.

David should “not fail to sit with the king at meat”, but he asks to go and hide himself in the field “unto the third day at even.” I’ma stay in the field until the third day at evening; I’m not coming to dinner with y’all, your father wants to kill me; I’ma hide in the woods for three nights.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: If Saul misses him, Jonathan is to say David asked leave to run to his city, “for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.” Your dad asks why I ain’t come to dinner, let him know I got a family situation I got to handle.
If Saul says “It is well”, all right, no problem, cool. But if he gets mad, “then be sure that evil is determined by him”: he wants to kill me, and you’re going to know the difference.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “Notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?” If I’m wrong, if I’m evil, you can kill me yourself; why bring me to your father to kill me? Jonathan answers that if he knew certainly evil was determined against David, “then would not I tell it thee?” If I knew he was going to kill you, I’ll tell you.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: Jonathan sets a sign. When he has sounded his father “about to morrow any time, or the third day”, if it is good he will not send; “but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace.” If it’s all good, I’ll call you; if it’s all bad, I’ll send you away. That’s all he’s saying.
Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, and caused David to swear again, “for he loved him as he loved his own soul.”

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: Again: “To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.” Say it again. “And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly” to the place where he hid himself, by the stone Ezel.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: Jonathan will shoot three arrows. If he tells the lad, “Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them”, then David is good, he’s safe: “for there is peace to thee, and no hurt”. But if he says, “Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way”, the arrows are too far for you to find, don’t worry about it, “for the Lord hath sent thee away”: go on somewhere.
“Behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever”: only you and I know about this plan, whether I shoot arrows in your favor or not in your favor.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.” Now the new moon’s coming in. At this time, when the new moon came in, where is David? Hiding in the field like he said he would. “And David’s place was empty.”

Saul spake not any thing that day, for he thought, “he is not clean; surely he is not clean.” Maybe he ain’t clean, that’s why he’s not here: that’s what he’s thinking. But he’s mad he ain’t show up, because he wants to kill David.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month”: now it’s the second day of the month, because remember, the new moon is the first day. They had dinner more than one day, so Saul asks, “Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?” Where he at now? Jonathan gives the excuse, “our family hath a sacrifice in the city”, he couldn’t make it. “Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.” This is day two.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan: “Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman”. He said your mom is rebellious, you evil as that. “Do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion”: you stupid as hell defending that boy, “and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness”: your mom is confused like you. He’s cursing them out.

“For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom.” You don’t understand: if this guy lives, you can’t be king. The Lord picked him as king. “Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die”: bring him here so I can kill him.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?” Kill him for what? What’d he do? Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him, “whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.” He’s trying to kill David, he’s trying to kill me too.

“So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month”: he got mad and left, “because his father had done him shame”, he was embarrassed. Read it back one more time: it is still the second day of the month. Those who say the new moon discerns the weekly Sabbath, notice: it says the second day of the month.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: In the morning Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed, with a little lad. Remember the message: if he tells the lad to go get the arrows, you good; if he says they’re too far to get, then you’re not safe. “And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him”, and Jonathan cried, “Is not the arrow beyond thee?” It was too far for you. “Make speed, haste, stay not”: don’t worry about the arrow, leave it alone.

“But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.” He didn’t know what was going on. Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, “Go, carry them to the city”: take my bow, my arrows, take them back to my house.
So far, this is day two. Remember David said it would be three days.
